disposition.item: No source says where the repeat of a proof-of-delivery read is counted when the read writes no second entry
disposition.change: Counter name removed; repeat counted once per read, counter location Not specified (GAP-0580).
disposition.note: Repeat counted once per read; no second ledger entry. Counter location Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0580).

edits.old: Until RWB-ACE-001 deploys the Section B views, the proof-of-delivery read is held behind the platform flag rwb.dataengine.pod-read. While the flag is off or the views are not deployed, the read answers 200 with no row, the proof-of-delivery field names marked not available with reason SECTION_B_NOT_DEPLOYED, freshness DP07 STALE and message MSG-P1-001. It never returns an empty list alone, never a guessed date and never a fallback to data_as_of.
edits.new: Until RWB-ACE-001 deploys the Section B views, the proof-of-delivery read is held behind a feature flag whose name is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0579). While the flag is off or the views are not deployed, the read's answer and its markers are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0579). It never returns an empty list alone, never a guessed date and never a fallback to data_as_of.

edits.old: A repeat proof-of-delivery read of the same business date is counted on the DP07 stamp of that business date: one increment of data_product_load.duplicate_count per repeat read. The repeat writes no interaction ledger row and no log-only hit.
edits.new: A repeat proof-of-delivery read of the same business date is counted once per repeat read; the counter and its location are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0580). The repeat writes no second interaction ledger entry.
